title: Ankhorage API
summary: Provides a framework-neutral executable API runtime and transport adapter contract.
purpose: Execute portable API definitions consistently while allowing framework-specific transports to remain replaceable adapters.
responsibilities: Normalize portable API requests and responses.
Register handlers and dispatch operations defined by portable API contracts.
Define the runtime boundary used by transport adapter packages.
boundaries: Does not own portable serializable API definitions.
Does not depend on Fastify, Next.js, React, filesystem routing, process state, or provider SDKs.
Does not own framework-specific server or route integration.
audience: Applications executing portable Ankhorage API definitions.
Transport adapters integrating the API runtime with web frameworks.
useCases: Register operation handlers for a portable API definition.
Dispatch a normalized request to the matching operation handler.
Integrate the same API runtime through different transport adapters.

architecture.role: Framework-neutral runtime boundary between portable API Contracts and framework transport adapters.
invariants: Portable serializable definitions remain owned by @ankhorage/contracts.
Framework-specific types and behavior remain outside the core runtime.
Transport adapters depend inward on this runtime boundary.
